description: Give the user a page where they attach files for a business: drawings, filled forms, photos of a defect, specifications. Files cannot travel through this tool, so the page is the way; the link works for 15 minutes. With case_id the files attach to that request; without one, the page sends them to the business as a new request.

business.description: Name of the business as it appears in list_my_businesses. Used only when business_id is not given. Leave both out when the user has one business, or to search every business the user has.

business_id.description: The business id exactly as given by list_my_businesses (for example yyigsmj5b7mcwxe7). Preferred: use it whenever you know it.

case_id.description: The request the files belong to, from `status` or from a request you just prepared. Optional.

note.description: One line on what the files are. Optional.

name: share
title: Send files to the business
